configurations.name: web-local-db
runtimeArgs: eval "$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(API_URL|ANON_KEY|SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)=')" && NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="$API_URL" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$ANON_KEY" SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="$SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3001 pnpm --filter @project23/web exec next start --port 3001
